name: Membership and Equivalence Queries Complexity of Addressing
proof: Restrict here to $n=2^r$ with all r-bit words present, so $\lfloor\log_2n\rfloor=\log_2n=r$. For the addressing family, Maass--Turán's table of matching bounds gives $\mathrm{LC}_{\mathrm{ARB\text{-}MEMB}}(\mathrm{ADDRESSING}_n)=\Theta(\log n)$, exactly the database's model with arbitrary equivalence and membership queries.
details: Scope: complete-code subfamily $n=2^r$, $r\ge1$. The displayed formula is not asserted for arbitrary injective encodings at other n.
